findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The fan guards of the cold room’s cooler were observed heavily accumulated with dust. The fans are above the table where food preparation occurs. Discussed and shown to PIC. Ensure that fan guards are cleaned as frequent as necessary to prevent possible food contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Several bags of shredded lettuce stored in the salad cooler were tempting between 53F - 57F. PIC stated that the bags of lettuce were placed in the cooler the night before. The bags of lettuce were discarded by the PIC. Be sure that TCS food items are held at of 41F or less to ensure proper cold holding temperatures. 

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.
